reviews.comment: Lectures were 90% proofs and 10% of the actual material we needed for the test, which made me (and many of my classmates) feeling like we left the classroom learning nothing. Lectures also weren't planned or thought out very well at all. Definitely would never take him again and I am glad that I no longer have to stress out over this class anymore.

Really good professor! He definitely understands the material, but more importantly, he's great at teaching more complex methods and topics (compared to STAT 211) to his students in a way that's easy to understand. You do some proofs in the class, but a lot of it boils down to knowing rudimentary stats and R programming. Great prof, great class

reviews.comment: Very nice guy, he's a graduate student-prof. HWs are R-heavy textbook problems and include occasional proofs, but I think HW helps you prep for exams (which don't have proofs). He and the TA teach R well, but having some prior coding knowledge would be helpful. Exams are on paper, no-R coding, and a "cheat sheet" is allowed, so no reason to fail :)
